verses.text: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the person who fears the LORD and finds real joy in his commands.
Their children will be mighty in the land. The generation of upright people will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in their home. Their righteousness lasts forever.
Light breaks through the dark for upright people, for the gracious, merciful, and righteous.
Things go well for the person who is generous and lends. They handle their affairs with justice.
They won’t ever be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
They won’t panic over bad news. Their heart is steady because they trust the LORD.
Their heart is secure. They won’t be afraid when they finally look on their enemies.
They’ve spread what they have around and given to poor people. Their righteousness lasts forever. Their strength will be lifted up in honor.
The wicked will see it and get upset. They’ll grind their teeth and melt away. What the wicked long for will come to nothing.
